# Windows Runtime metadata: %SystemRoot%\System32\WinMetadata\Windows.*.winmd.
#
# The .NET Framework resolves a Windows Runtime type through RoResolveNamespace (wintypes.dll) to one
# of these files and reads the type from it (InspectorOfficeGadget.exe of Microsoft 365 Apps uses
# Windows.Management.Deployment.PackageManager, for example). Microsoft's files cannot be shipped:
# these are generated by widl --winmd from the Windows Runtime IDL files in sdk/include/psdk (from
# Wine). A file holds the types that its IDL file defines and is named like its namespace (the lookup
# is by file name and case-sensitive, like on Windows).
#
# Windows.Foundation.winmd also holds what the imported windows.foundation.collections.idl,
# asyncinfo.idl, eventtoken.idl and ivectorchangedeventargs.idl define (Windows.Foundation.Collections,
# IAsyncInfo, AsyncStatus, EventRegistrationToken), with the parameterized interfaces and delegates
# (IAsyncOperation`1, IIterable`1 and the like), as on Windows: --winmd-merge.

if(MSVC)
    # widl --winmd is not available with the MIDL toolchain
    return()
endif()

list(APPEND WINMETADATA
    windows.foundation:Windows.Foundation
    windows.applicationmodel:Windows.ApplicationModel
    windows.applicationmodel.activation:Windows.ApplicationModel.Activation
    windows.applicationmodel.background:Windows.ApplicationModel.Background
    windows.applicationmodel.core:Windows.ApplicationModel.Core
    windows.devices.geolocation:Windows.Devices.Geolocation
    windows.devices.input:Windows.Devices.Input
    windows.management.deployment:Windows.Management.Deployment
    windows.storage:Windows.Storage
    windows.storage.fileproperties:Windows.Storage.FileProperties
    windows.storage.search:Windows.Storage.Search
    windows.storage.streams:Windows.Storage.Streams
    windows.system:Windows.System
    windows.ui:Windows.UI
    windows.ui.input:Windows.UI.Input)

set(WINMETADATA_MERGE_Windows.Foundation
    --winmd-merge=windows.foundation.collections.idl --winmd-merge=asyncinfo.idl
    --winmd-merge=eventtoken.idl --winmd-merge=ivectorchangedeventargs.idl)

set(_psdk ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/psdk)
# Every file imports others: any of them changes the output
file(GLOB _idl_deps ${_psdk}/windows.*.idl)
list(APPEND _idl_deps ${_psdk}/asyncinfo.idl ${_psdk}/eventtoken.idl ${_psdk}/ivectorchangedeventargs.idl
                      ${_psdk}/windowscontracts.idl ${_psdk}/inspectable.idl ${_psdk}/hstring.idl)
set(_outputs "")
foreach(_item ${WINMETADATA})
    string(REPLACE ":" ";" _pair ${_item})
    list(GET _pair 0 _idl)
    list(GET _pair 1 _name)
    set(_out ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${_name}.winmd)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${_out}
        COMMAND native-widl -I${_psdk} --winmd ${WINMETADATA_MERGE_${_name}} -o ${_out} ${_psdk}/${_idl}.idl
        DEPENDS ${_idl_deps} native-widl
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
        VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND _outputs ${_out})
endforeach()

add_custom_target(winmetadata ALL DEPENDS ${_outputs})

foreach(_out ${_outputs})
    add_cd_file(TARGET winmetadata FILE ${_out} DESTINATION reactos/system32/WinMetadata FOR all)
endforeach()
